BRAKE SYSTEM – TRACTION CONTROL SYSTEM (TRAC)

Tc Terminal Circuit

CIRCUIT DESCRIPTION

By connecting terminals Tc and E1 of DLC1 or DLC2, the ECU displays the diagnostic trouble code
by blinking the TRAC indicator light.
